title: Fuel-bounded circuit combination
statement: Given a Boolean $b$, a natural-number fuel value, and a list of Boolean tree circuits, recursively combine circuits using the gate selected by $b$. With zero fuel, return one node of that gate with the entire list as children; with positive fuel, return that gate node on an empty list, return the sole circuit unchanged on a singleton list, and otherwise pair adjacent circuits using that gate and recurse on the resulting list with one less unit of fuel.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a list of Boolean tree circuits on $n$ variables
